answer: Your records don't list any allergies. The allergy list is empty in all three sets of records from the hospital (pulled in February 2024, February 2025 and October 2026). That means none has been recorded. It does not prove you have none, because an empty list can also mean allergies were never asked about or entered. If you know of a reaction to a medicine, food or latex, tell your care team so they can add it.
short: No allergies are recorded in her records, but an empty list does not prove she has none.
